#!/usr/bin/env python3

from Crypto.Util.number import getPrime, bytes_to_long

with open('flag.txt', 'rb') as f:
    flag = f.read()

p = getPrime(1024)
q = getPrime(1024)
r = getPrime(1024)

n1 = p * q
n2 = p * r
n3 = q * r

moduli = [n1, n2, n3]

e = 65537
c = bytes_to_long(flag)

for n in moduli:
    c = pow(c, e, n)

    f.write(f'e: {e}\n')
